label: Male
notes: Coded 0/1 (the source Stata file carried outdated 1/2 labels from the unrecoded item). Same 2,000 students as disc, in the same row order.

label: Home language is not English
values: 0 = English (including students who skipped the item); 1 = another language
notes: From NELS item BYS22, the language usually spoken at home: 1 = codes 2 to 13; 0 = English (197) or a legitimate skip (1,560). Coded 0/1 (the source Stata file carried outdated 1-13 language labels).

label: Has own bedroom
notes: Coded 0/1 (the source Stata file carried outdated 1/2 labels). Same as disc$bedroom.

label: Times sent to the office for misbehaving
values: 0 = never; 1 = once or twice; 2 = more than twice

label: Socioeconomic status composite
notes: NELS base-year composite BYSES, built from parents' education and occupations and family income.

label: Reading score, 10th grade (1990)
notes: NELS first follow-up composite F12XRSTD. Most NAs (215 of 218) are students who did not complete the test.

label: Father graduated from college
notes: Derived from disc$bys34a: 1 = codes 5 to 7 (college graduate, master's, Ph.D./M.D.).

label: Father finished high school
values: 0 = did not finish high school; 1 = high school graduate or more

label: Mother graduated from college
notes: Derived from disc$bys34b: 1 = codes 5 to 7 (college graduate, master's, Ph.D./M.D.).

label: Mother finished high school
values: 0 = did not finish high school; 1 = high school graduate or more

label: Racial/ethnic minority
values: 0 = White; 1 = Asian, Hispanic, Black or American Indian
notes: Derived from NELS bys31a; NA for the 24 nonrespondents.

label: Race/ethnicity
values: Asian; Hispanic; Black; White; American Indian
notes: Factor built from NELS bys31a (Asian = Asian or Pacific Islander), as in disc. The American Indian level was added in v1.0.0 for 68 students who were NA before; the 24 nonrespondents are NA.

label: Ever sent to the office for misbehaving
notes: Recode of osentoff (1 = codes 1 and 2); same as disc$sentoff.
